scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM)
scholarships.covers: Tuition + travel + monthly living allowance (varies by programme)
scholarships.how: Apply directly to each EMJM programme (usually 1 application per programme, scholarship ticked inside). Deadlines differ per programme (typically Oct-Feb).
scholarships.reality: Only a few Civil/Transport/Water EMJMs exist - filter the catalogue by Engineering. Date shown is a planning estimate, not one fixed deadline.

scholarships.name: DAAD Scholarships (umbrella, Germany)
scholarships.covers: Monthly stipend, insurance, travel (varies by DAAD programme)
scholarships.how: Search the DAAD scholarship database for Bangladesh + Master's + Engineering; each programme has its own deadline and portal.
scholarships.reality: 'DAAD' is not one scholarship. Many close Oct-Nov. Check the database filter for Bangladesh before spending time.

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS (Development-Related Postgraduate Courses)
scholarships.covers: Monthly stipend, health insurance, travel allowance (for listed courses only)
scholarships.how: Apply directly to the listed postgraduate course (max 3). Needs 2 years professional experience + development-related motivation.
scholarships.reality: Deadline is per course. Only confirmed date found: Freiburg MEG closed 15 Oct 2026. Civil/water-relevant EPOS courses: TU Dresden Hydro Science & Engineering, Bauhaus-Uni Weimar NHRE (Natural Hazards & Risks in Structural Eng.), TU Darmstadt TropHEE - check each course site.
scholarships.conf: DAAD EPOS list (06/2026) via secondary sites

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
scholarships.covers: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend, accommodation allowance, health insurance
scholarships.how: Online application (DreamApply portal) + nomination through Bangladesh sending partner. English B2 certificate, motivation letter, CV, transcripts, medical certificate.
scholarships.reality: Last cycle deadline was 15 Jan 2026; 2027/28 date is the same pattern - confirm when portal opens (Oct-Nov). Check which Hungarian universities offer Civil/Transport MSc.

scholarships.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
scholarships.covers: Tuition, living allowance, travel grant, insurance
scholarships.how: Step 1: apply to eligible Swedish master's via University Admissions (16 Oct 2026 - 15 Jan 2027). Step 2: SI scholarship portal (last cycle 9-25 Feb). Work/leadership experience required.
scholarships.reality: Date shown is the university-application deadline (the real gate). SI scholarship portal expected ~Feb 2027. Look at KTH / Chalmers / Lund transport programmes.

scholarships.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.funding: Partial (stipend; tuition often waived by host)
scholarships.covers: EUR 1,200/month (Master), international travel, insurance. Tuition NOT covered by Eiffel itself
scholarships.how: You cannot apply directly. A French institution nominates you - contact the programme in Oct-Nov; their internal deadline is earlier than the Campus France date.
scholarships.reality: Date = institution deadline to Campus France (sources say 6-8 Jan 2027). Your real deadline is the university's internal one (Nov-Dec 2026).

scholarships.name: Master Mind Scholarship
scholarships.covers: Unverified - confirm on official Study-in-Flanders / university pages
scholarships.how: Check official page of the Belgian university you target.
scholarships.reality: Taken from your list (Jan-Apr 2027); I could not confirm details. Treat as LOW confidence until verified.

scholarships.name: VLIR-UOS Scholarships
scholarships.covers: Tuition, travel, living allowance, insurance
scholarships.how: Apply to the specific VLIR-UOS programme (e.g. water-resources ICPs) + scholarship form; deadlines differ per programme.
scholarships.reality: Best for Water Resources track. Confirm Bangladesh eligibility on the current country list.

scholarships.name: ARES Scholarships
scholarships.covers: Allowance, tuition, travel (country-specific)
scholarships.how: Via ARES-listed programmes; country eligibility is restricted.
scholarships.reality: Bangladesh may not be on the eligible list - verify first. Low confidence.

scholarships.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.covers: Monthly stipend, tuition exemption, insurance, housing allowance
scholarships.how: Via Swiss embassy / ESKAS.
scholarships.reality: As far as I know this programme funds research (PhD/postdoc) and arts masters, NOT a taught MSc in Civil Engineering. Skip for a Master's; keep for a future PhD. Verify on ESKAS site.

scholarships.name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship (ESOP)
scholarships.covers: Living support (~CHF 12,000/semester-based package) + tuition waiver (verify current figures)
scholarships.how: Apply to an ETH MSc (application window ~1 Nov - 15 Dec) and tick the scholarship option; very competitive (top ~1-2%).
scholarships.reality: ETH has strong Transport (IVT) and Civil programmes. Date = usual ETH MSc deadline for autumn intake - confirm on ethz.ch.

scholarships.name: EPFL Excellence Fellowships (Master)
scholarships.covers: Fellowship toward living costs (amount per EPFL page)
scholarships.how: Apply to EPFL MSc (Civil Engineering) with the standard application; excellent applicants are considered.
scholarships.reality: Your list says Nov 2026-Apr 2027; EPFL Master admission usually closes mid-Dec for autumn entry - confirm.

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship
scholarships.covers: EUR 10,000 stipend + full tuition fee waiver (1 year)
scholarships.how: Apply to an Irish HEI first; then scholarship application via the HEA portal.
scholarships.reality: Window shown is estimated from your list (Jan-Mar 2027). Confirm exact dates in Jan.

scholarships.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT)
scholarships.covers: ~EUR 9,000/year + insurance (check current call)
scholarships.how: Pre-enrol at Italian university via Universitaly, apply for IYT through the Italian MFA portal.
scholarships.reality: Window from your list. Confirm Bangladesh is included in the current call.

scholarships.name: Holland Scholarship
scholarships.covers: EUR 5,000 one-time payment in year 1 only
scholarships.how: Apply through the Dutch institution (deadline set by each university, commonly 1 Feb or 1 May).
scholarships.reality: NOT a full scholarship - EUR 5,000 only. Do not count it as 'full funded'.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.covers: Tuition, living stipend, return flights, visa fee
scholarships.how: Online application with 3 UK course choices. Needs 2 years (2,800 hrs) work experience and intent to return home for 2 years.
scholarships.reality: Closed for 2027/28 (closed 6 Oct 2026, 11:00 UTC). Next cycle should open ~Aug 2027 - start building work experience & essays now.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarship (UK)
scholarships.covers: Tuition, airfare, living stipend
scholarships.how: Apply on CSC Central (3 UK universities ranked); also follow your nominating agency's process. Needs 2:1 or equivalent. Only 1-year TAUGHT masters; research masters not funded.
scholarships.reality: Closes 20 OCT 2026, 16:00 BST - tomorrow. Nominating agencies can have earlier internal deadlines. Check immediately.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarship (UK)
scholarships.covers: Fees, stipend, airfare
scholarships.how: CSC Central.
scholarships.reality: PhD only - not relevant for a Master's. Keep for later.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship (UK)
scholarships.covers: Tuition, stipend, airfare
scholarships.how: Applied for through participating UK universities, not directly to CSC.
scholarships.reality: Dates from your list; each university sets its own cut-off. Confirm on the target university's scholarship page.

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship
scholarships.covers: Fees, stipend, flights, visa
scholarships.bd: Check Rhodes eligibility checker for your constituency
scholarships.how: Apply via your constituency (separate deadlines).
scholarships.reality: Closed for the 2027 intake (constituency deadlines were Aug-early Oct 2026). Latest known: 7 Oct. Next cycle opens ~Jun 2027.

scholarships.name: Clarendon Scholarship (Oxford)
scholarships.covers: Course fees + living grant
scholarships.how: No separate form - apply to an Oxford graduate course by its Dec 2026 or Jan 2027 deadline and you are auto-considered.
scholarships.reality: Deadline is on each course page (Dec or Jan). Applications after that are generally not considered.

scholarships.name: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarship (Oxford)
scholarships.covers: Fees + leadership programme (verify)
scholarships.how: Via Oxford graduate application by Dec/Jan deadline; may need extra form.
scholarships.reality: Verify eligibility list & course restrictions on the official page.

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.covers: Full cost: fees, maintenance, flights, visa
scholarships.how: Apply through Cambridge graduate portal, tick Gates Cambridge. Deadline is course-dependent: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027.
scholarships.reality: About two-thirds of awards go to PhD students; Master's (MPhil/MRes) odds are lower. Check your course's funding deadline.

scholarships.name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
scholarships.covers: Undergrad fees + living costs
scholarships.how: n/a
scholarships.reality: Undergraduate only - NOT for a Master's. Remove from your plan.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships (UK)
scholarships.covers: GBP 10,000 towards tuition at participating universities
scholarships.how: Via each participating UK university's scholarship page.
scholarships.reality: Partial funding only (~GBP 10k). Deadline set per university.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Bangladesh)
scholarships.covers: Tuition, stipend, health plan, travel (J-1)
scholarships.bd: Yes - Bangladeshi citizen resident in Bangladesh
scholarships.how: Online application via US Embassy Dhaka / IIE. No foreign master's degree; priority to junior faculty & professionals with relevant experience.
scholarships.reality: Closed for 2027-28 (11 Jul 2026). Next call (2028-29) expected ~May-Jul 2027 - one of the best funded routes to a US MS, so plan early.

scholarships.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition + stipend for up to 3 years
scholarships.how: Separate KHS application + Stanford degree application (by 1 Dec 2026 to stay eligible). Bachelor's earned Jan 2020 or later.

Dr. Hackl's research focuses on complex infrastructure systems, intelligent risk and resilience assessments to climate change, as well as integrated solutions to future challenges facing our cities and society. His research interests lie at the interface between formal methods in network sciences and their integration with prevailing simulation methods, such as digital twins. He is particularly interested in developing scalable data analytics and machine learning techniques for spatial-temporal networks applied to dynamic processes in complex multiscale civil engineered systems to open and interconnect new perspectives for, e.g., modeling of usage, behavior, and performance; analysis of system integration; as well as detection of systemic risks in socio-technical systems. Another aspect of his work covers integrating these data-driven approaches with physics-based models to create digital twins that can learn from and update based on multiple data sources, as well as represent and predict the current and future conditions of their physical counterparts.

Dr. Getachew’s research focuses on understanding the performance of “smart materials” in the context of water treatment technologies and systems. Smart materials, also called responsive materials, undergo significant physico-chemical changes in response to external stimuli. Their dynamic behavior can be used for sensing, actuating, self-healing, and controlled-release applications, among many others. Smart materials could play a role in enhancing the versatility and sustainability of water treatment technologies and systems but advances in the design and synthesis of such functional materials are currently focused on and driven by applications outside the environmental engineering field. Research in Dr. Getachew’s lab aims to 1) evaluate the performance of different kinds of smart materials in environmentally relevant conditions, 2) integrate them into water treatment technologies and assess their performance against state-of-the-art technologies, and 3) design new materials and composite structures to enable previously unavailable functionalities.
